You can take the tour again any time: /help.
onboarding.startGreeting:
Hi! I'm **{{assistantName}}** — your personal assistant for money, tasks, and thoughts.

You don't need commands: write or speak to me like a friend.

**Things you can just do in the chat:**
• 🎙 **By voice** — "spent 12 euros on lunch", "buy milk tomorrow", a thought for the inbox.
• 🧾 **By photo** — a receipt, a bill, or a balance screenshot: I'll read the amount and record it.
• 💬 **By text** — a question or a request: "how are my finances?", "what's on for today?".
• 📱 **The "{{assistantName}}" button** next to the input opens the visual dashboard.

Quick summaries are on the keyboard below; the full list is in /help.
onboarding.introText:
👋 We haven't met yet: I'm {{assistantName}}, your personal assistant for money, tasks, and energy.

Write or speak your thoughts, spending, and ideas — I quietly file them in the inbox and help you make sense of them. I also understand photos of receipts, bills, and balance screenshots.
onboarding.introOptionalKey: 🔑 **Your own key — optional.** Everything already works. If you ever want to connect a personal model key, you can do it later via /help: the key is stored encrypted and never shown in the chat.
onboarding.currencyPrompt: 💱 **Pick your base currency** — I'll use it for totals, balances, and spending. You can change it later by tapping another button here or in the dashboard settings.
onboarding.currencySaved:
✅ Base currency: **{{currency}}**.

You can change it later in the dashboard or with another button in this message.
onboarding.stepOverviewBody:
I quietly take the routine off your hands:
• 📥 **Thought inbox:** write or speak — I'll keep the essence.
• 🎯 **Focus 1+3:** one main goal and three small things a day.
• 💰 **Money:** multi-currency accounts, spending, and payment schedules.
• 🧾 **Receipts and screenshots:** take a photo — I'll read the amount and record it.
• 📱 **Mini App:** a visual dashboard right inside Telegram.
onboarding.stepTimezoneBody: The timezone lets me send the morning summary on time and keeps reminders from waking you at night.
onboarding.stepCurrencyBody: {{assistantName}} uses this currency for overall balances, monthly spending, and your financial reserve.
onboarding.stepAccountsBody: To track money, create your basic accounts in one tap. You can set up any others later in the Mini App.
onboarding.stepPracticeBody:
Try it right now — no commands needed:
• A thought or idea by voice or text
• Spending: "lunch 15" or "coffee 3.5"
• A task: "buy milk tomorrow"
• A photo of a receipt or a balance screenshot

Or create a sample task or note with the button below.
onboarding.demoSeedApplied: ✅ Demo data added: accounts, tasks, notes, and a recurring obligation are ready to explore.
onboarding.sampleTaskCreated: ✅ Sample task created and added to focus.
onboarding.sampleNoteCreated: ✅ Sample note saved to the inbox.
onboarding.sampleTaskNotes: First task created in the tour wizard
onboarding.sampleNoteText: 💡 My first thought in {{assistantName}}: everything genius is simple!
onboarding.sampleNoteResult: Sample note saved to the inbox: "{{title}}".
onboarding.stepNotificationsBody: Every morning {{assistantName}} can send a short summary: the day's tasks, account balances, and reminders.
onboarding.stepNotificationsQuestion: What time should the morning summary arrive?
onboarding.stepGeminiBody:
• I reply in plain language and decide what to do myself: record spending, create a task, find a note.
• Voice, text, and photos are handled by an AI model.
onboarding.modelSharedLimit: • The shared key has a welcome limit of **${{limitUsd}}** — usually enough for weeks of normal use.
onboarding.modelOwnKey: • If you ever want your own model key, it is optional and can be set up later via /help.
onboarding.stepFinalBody:
{{assistantName}} is ready. What to do next:
• 🎙 Speak or write your thoughts — I'll keep them in the inbox.
• 🧾 Send photos of receipts and balance screenshots.
• 💬 Ask in plain language — I'll work it out.
• 📱 Open the Mini App with the button below for the visual dashboard.

Help and the tour again — /help.
